lines.speaker: camp_clerk
lines.text: There's a trailer on the north side with a crate of notebooks in it. Came down from the campus on a truck and never went back up.

lines.speaker: camp_clerk
lines.text: Foreman has a work order to burn them Friday. I asked why. I was told that it was a work order, which is not an answer to why, which is exactly why I am telling you about it.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: That is four years of my handwriting. Every derivation, in order. They took the bench notes when they took the vote and I never found out where they went.

choices.text: You remember the work. Let the paper go.
